hypotheses.justification: Its only use is proving hprev_le. Replace that line with `have hprev_le : n - 1 ≤ n := Nat.sub_le n 1`; the remaining proof is unchanged. All invoked lemmas allow n = 0, where truncated subtraction gives n - 1 = 0.

Only the radial-support step uses hB. Split on 0 ≤ B and retain the existing proof in that case. If B < 0, the independently established hout makes axialDensity vanish at every nonnegative radius. Thus its primitive from 0 to any positive R is zero, using intervalIntegral.integral_congr and integral_zero, so axialStress is zero there. At nonpositive radii it is zero by the definition of stress. Consequently radialSupport holds everywhere; the smoothness and derivative proofs remain unchanged.
